# openworld/pinnacle: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

Pinnacle: the first site cut off the scale model into the open world (openworld/PLAN-SITES.md): a 60 km square round Pinnacle Rock on map 5.1 (moved by the owner 2026-11-10 to the savage hyperjungle's north-east edge) and, since 2026-11-11, 10 km corridors along the roads to its bands' raid and trade partners (Port Goto, Talon, Fort Kreia, Mav's Refuge, Nusidi, Fort Ordo, Coyote Canyon, Shade: the Ancient network's routes or guides), at 1:1 on core/world, the hyperjungle and the NE and E rims' savannah kit growing on it, and the site planned on that ground as records (core/world KSITES, baked to plan/sites.json): the nine Beast Rider bands' camps on the floor round the rock (core/camp) and their tracks to it, and the eight links laid with their caravanserais, rest stops and bridges (the sim's S5 graph, core/world KTRAVEL). The town on the mesa is settlements/pinnacle-rock's own. Verified: build.py, verify.py --assert. Read README.md

Docs: `KNOWN_ISSUES.md`, `PLAN.md`, `PORT.md`, `README.md`
